name: The continuous roller: one long developing main, a short subtraction

provenance.knowledge: authored: the research manual's arrangement grammars (§4), its lengths and weights as listening hypotheses; no record's arrangement copied
provenance.note: mixing intro (16 or 32, 1:2) → establishment (a drop of 16) → the long developing main (64, 96 or 128, 3:2:1; it takes up a longer theme) → a subtraction (8 or 16, 2:1: the harmony with hints of the drums 2, a restrained pulse 1, nothing 1) → outro (16 or 32, 1:2). No large drum-free breakdown: the main moves by the phrases' own development.
